decision: DIFFERS -> W1: author the page's figure. usu_ext shallots-in-the-garden (the shallot-specific page) states "Bulb sets should be planted at 3–6 inches apart in rows 12–18 inches apart." -> in_row [3,6], row [12,18]. Today's [6,8] has no page for 8 (UMD's '8 inches apart for large bulbs' is bulb-onion scope; UF Gardening Solutions gives 'about six inches'). Ten prose strings restating 6-8 are re-authored to 3-6; container notes (6 in) and the 6-inch yield note sit inside the range.
